description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Fire], [Awoken Fire], [Damage Cap +10000], [Physical Blink 3] and [Footwork Mode] to the user

description.name: Awoken Fire
description.text: Fire abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Fire abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Attach Fire
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Fire damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Fire resistance +20%

description.name: Physical Blink 3
description.text: Evades the next 3 PHY attacks that deal physical, missing HP or fixed damage or NAT attacks that deal physical or fractional damage

description.name: Footwork Mode
description.text: Critical chance =100%, cast speed x2.00, casts Streaking Fist after using three Monk abilities, removed if user hasn't any Physical Blink

description.name: Streaking Fist
description.text: Six single attacks (1.02 each), 100% hit rate, grants [Physical Blink 3] to the user
